12.        At about 1605 hours, DO LAM Ho-chun reported to me that
SFn HO, unconscious, was located at the open ground in front
of the front entrance of Wang Tai House and received
immediate medical assistance on-site. Subsequently, SFn HO

[Question 9(a) continued]

13.         At 1618 hours, AD(NTN) TANG Wing-wah assumed the role
of Incident Commander, and I briefed him on the situation
regarding the progress of firefighting and rescue operations for
the affected buildings as well as the result of the Mayday
operation. At 1623 hours, AD(NTN) assigned me the role of
Rescue Officer, giving me responsibility for the overall Search
and Rescue (“SAR”) operations.
